summary: Formal verification of 'Creamos tu tarjeta' (BRUNO + OVC) service. Backend 9/9 pytest pass (locale, header spoof ignored, 403 no-origin, 400 consent/FR/fake-PDF, one valid 201 with server-side COP 30000, idempotent replay, admin list 200 / non-admin 403). Frontend: profile Cards-tab bubble, /website banner, redirect, ES/EN toggle without reload + persistence, country/price independent of language, 6 example links, contact-only payment panel, no horizontal overflow at 390/1920 all verified. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: consent only accepted when value == 'on'; 'true' is rejected with 400 (review request says 'true'/'on'). The browser form sends 'on' so the UI works; native/API clients sending 'true' would fail.

Rate limit (5/IP/hour) is counted BEFORE validation and BEFORE the idempotency check: invalid attempts and idempotent retries consume quota, so a user who retries after a network error can get 429 instead of their existing reference. Limit is also in-memory (resets on restart, not shared across workers) and keyed on the first X-Forwarded-For entry (client-spoofable).
_origin_ok accepts any *.emergentagent.com / *.emergent.host origin, so any other preview app can post cross-site. Consider restricting to the app's own host + brunocard.com in production.

ui_bugs.issue: The top-nav BRUNO logo (and footer brand logo) link to '#inicio' (scroll to top), so they do NOT return to the profile. Only the footer 'BRUNOCARD.COM ↗' link triggers the bridge back() to ?from (verified it returns to /my-profile?tab=cards). If 'logo returns to profile' is a requirement, bridge must also hook a.brand.

issues: Mixed language: heading/description hard-coded in Spanish while the banner button label follows serviceLang() (shows English 'Your world, in one card...' on en browsers).

documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth (pass), but body.scrollWidth=425 because .orbit decorations overflow; currently masked by html,body{overflow-x:hidden}. Acceptable, just noting it is clipped rather than sized.
